author: mrbese
name: BESE Tokenizer + Extended Value Embeddings + XSA-all-11
blurb: Novel BESE tokenizer (38 structured base tokens + 249 BPE merges = 287 vocab) replacing SentencePiece-1024. 33% fewer tokens per byte (0.51 vs 0.76). Extended Value Embeddings to layers 4-10 for deeper token identity re-injection. Built on PR #1019 architecture (XSA-all-11, GPTQ int6, Muon, EMA/SWA, BigramHash 3072x112).
technique_summary: BESE-287 tokenizer + VE layers 4-10 + XSA-all-11 + GPTQ int6 + BigramHash 3072x112 + LZMA9
